goal: A private cross-device weekly book/music/film sampler with authorized previews and transparent deterministic taste learning.

tasks.description: Create independently testable app foundation and shared domain contracts
tasks.expected_output: Pinned lockfile, validated env, minimal app shell, passing foundation checks

tasks.description: Implement fail-closed GitHub allowlisted auth and same-origin request guards
tasks.expected_output: Personal endpoints deny absent/disallowed sessions and missing auth configuration

tasks.description: Implement migrations, owner-qualified repositories and privacy deletion
tasks.expected_output: Transactional persistence with tested isolation and deletion

tasks.description: Implement domain validation and review-first history parsing
tasks.expected_output: Generic/IMDb/library fixtures parsed without false taste or identity inference

tasks.description: Implement bounded catalog lookup, cache, approved ingestion and minimal booklist import
tasks.expected_output: Verified canonical metadata, pending ambiguous records, quota-safe adapters

tasks.description: Implement pure per-medium taste, diversity selection, reasons and local-week rules
tasks.expected_output: Deterministic scoring independent of samples/free access with grounded explanations

tasks.description: Implement authorized sample/access resolution and cache prewarming
tasks.expected_output: TMDB trailer IDs, Google Books links and iTunes samples without search/model API

tasks.description: Probe real capabilities and ingest at least 30 reviewed works per medium
tasks.expected_output: Actual identity/playback/terms report and diverse live starter corpus
One atomic stable edition per local week using cached sample metadata

tasks.description: Implement complete private UI, feedback, imports, saved works and learning
tasks.expected_output: Cross-device finite edition and editable source-tagged learning with deletion/export

tasks.description: Audit release and deploy only with explicit approval
tasks.expected_output: Passing unit/integration/e2e/build checks and real independent production verification

success_criteria: No provider calls on ordinary page refresh
No model or YouTube Data API calls
Actual live verification before deployment claims
external_inputs: App-specific GitHub OAuth client and allowed numeric user ID
deferred: Spotify functionality subject to policy review
